caption: MedClear helps explain medicine instructions that can be hard to read. Use it for information, and always confirm details with your doctor. It cannot replace care from a trained health professional.
speech: MedClear helps explain medicine instructions that can be hard to read. Use it for information, and always confirm details with your doctor. It cannot replace care from a trained health professional.

caption: Choose a clear photo, or take one with your camera. Check the preview carefully before asking the app to read the instructions for you.
speech: Choose a clear photo, or take one with your camera. Check the preview carefully before asking the app to read the instructions for you.

caption: This walkthrough uses a sample prescription already stored inside the app. It follows the full example without sending your photo anywhere or contacting a service.
speech: This walkthrough uses a sample prescription already stored inside the app. It follows the full example without sending your photo anywhere or contacting a service.

caption: The first medicine appears on a card with a plain explanation. It lists simple instructions, common effects, and useful things to watch for each day.
speech: The first medicine appears on a card with a plain explanation. It lists simple instructions, common effects, and useful things to watch for each day.

caption: Some writing is unclear, and the app points it out instead of guessing. Check the package, or ask your pharmacist to confirm the details.
speech: Some writing is unclear, and the app points it out instead of guessing. Check the package, or ask your pharmacist to confirm the details.

caption: The schedule groups medicines across morning, afternoon, evening, and night. We mark two sample items as taken, so the check marks appear on screen.
speech: The schedule groups medicines across morning, afternoon, evening, and night. We mark two sample items as taken, so the check marks appear on screen.

caption: The sample safety check shows two products may share an ingredient. Ask your pharmacist to check both labels before you use both medicines together.
speech: The sample safety check shows two products may share an ingredient. Ask your pharmacist to check both labels before you use both medicines together.

caption: The sample also flags medicines that may not mix well. Ask your pharmacist about this warning, and follow the original instructions. Do not change how you take any medicine based on this.
speech: The sample also flags medicines that may not mix well. Ask your pharmacist about this warning, and follow the original instructions. Do not change how you take any medicine based on this.

caption: The app can show explanations in Spanish and French as well. Medicine names remain in English, while the other words change on screen for clarity.
speech: The app can show explanations in Spanish and French as well. Medicine names remain in English, while the other words change on screen for clarity.

caption: MedClear cannot tell you what illness you have, or replace expert care. Always confirm your medicine instructions with your doctor. Ask your pharmacist whenever an instruction is unclear.
speech: MedClear cannot tell you what illness you have, or replace expert care. Always confirm your medicine instructions with your doctor. Ask your pharmacist whenever an instruction is unclear.
